mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmDlInvoiceNoPopList*/ SELECT WIDT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, WIDT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, WIDT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, WIDT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, WIDT.PO_QTY AS PO_QTY, WIDT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, WIDT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, WIDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, WIDT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, WIDT.INV_QTY AS INV_QTY, WIDT.UNIT_AMT AS UNIT_AMT, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, WIDT.BUYER AS BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO AS IK_NO, WIDT.INV_SEQ AS IK_SEQ, WIDT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, WIDT.S_INV_NO AS S_INV_NO, WIDT.S_INV_SEQ AS S_INV_SEQ, (SELECT MAX(DOC_TYPE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO) AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE((SELECT MAX(DOC_TYPE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO), 'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO, DECODE(WIDT.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','TR','1','재고','3','VMI')||DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','(선입고)','X','(KEPMRO)','(일반)') AS PROCESS_TEXT, WIDT.PROCESS_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT NVL(BUYER.AUTO_GR_FLAG,'N') FROM KEP_BUYER_FLAG BUYER WHERE BUYER.COM_CODE = WIDT.BUYER) AS AUTO_GR_FLAG FROM WMSIVDT WIDT, ICOMPODT PODT , ICOMPOHD POHD WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND WIDT.INV_NO =#{st_ik_no} AND WIDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND WIDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND WIDT.PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND WIDT.INV_QTY <> WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY WIDT.BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO, WIDT.INV_SEQ
mapper.update: /*insertMasterWmDlInvoiceNoPop1*/ UPDATE WMSIVDT WIDT SET WIDT.STATUS = 'R', WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE = #{st_delivery_date}, WIDT.DELIVERY_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY = NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0), WIDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY = #{st_delivery_company}, WIDT.DELIVERY_NO = #{st_delivery_no}, WIDT.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), WIDT.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS'), WIDT.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE = SYSDATE, WIDT.DELIVERY_ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{st_ik_no} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D'

/*insertMasterWmDlInvoiceNoPop2*/ UPDATE ICOMIVDT A SET A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS'), A.GR_QTY = NVL((SELECT SUM(B.INV_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE =#{st_warehouse_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.INV_NO = B.S_INV_NO AND A.INV_SEQ = B.S_INV_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0), A.DELIVERY_QTY = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) IN ('1','3') THEN NVL((SELECT SUM(B.DELIVERY_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.INV_NO = B.S_INV_NO AND A.INV_SEQ = B.S_INV_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0) ELSE A.DELIVERY_QTY END, A.DELIVERY_DATE = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) IN ('1','3') THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ELSE A.DELIVERY_DATE END, A.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) IN ('1','3') THEN SYSDATE ELSE A.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE END, A.DELIVERY_ADD_USER_ID = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) IN ('1','3') THEN #{st_user_id} ELSE A.DELIVERY_ADD_USER_ID END WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND (A.INV_NO,A.INV_SEQ) IN (SELECT S_INV_NO, S_INV_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND INV_NO =#{st_ik_no} AND STATUS <> 'D')

/*insertMasterWmDlInvoiceNoPop3*/
UPDATE ICOMPODT A SET A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS'), A.DI_QTY = NVL((SELECT SUM(B.DELIVERY_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0) WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND (A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ) IN (SELECT PO_NO, PO_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND INV_NO =#{st_ik_no} AND STATUS <> 'D')

UPDATE WMSSTCK SET TOT_QTY = TOT_QTY - (#{INV_QTY}), ALLOC_QTY = ALLOC_QTY - (#{INV_QTY}), CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_USER = #{st_user_id} WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND STDCATLG_ID = #{CMS_CATLG_ID} AND AGENT = DECODE(#{PROCESS_TYPE},'1','KRKORE0001',(SELECT WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ}))
mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmDlInvoiceNoPopGrList*/ SELECT WIDT.BUYER AS KEY_BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO AS KEY_INV_NO, TO_CHAR(WIDT.INV_SEQ) AS KEY_INV_SEQ, TO_CHAR(WIDT.INV_QTY) AS KEY_INV_QTY, WIDT.PO_NO AS KEY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(WIDT.PO_SEQ) AS KEY_PO_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WIDT, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{IK_NO} AND PODT.BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = WIDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D'

/*selectMasterWmDlInvoiceNoPopGrQtyCheck*/ SELECT (#{KEY_INV_QTY} + NVL(GR_QTY,0)) - NVL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY FROM ( SELECT NVL(B.GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY -- 기입고수량 , B.ITEM_QTY , DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',NVL(C.INV_QTY,0),NVL(D.INV_QTY,0)) AS INV_QTY -- 송장수량 FROM ICOMPODT B, ICOMIVDT C, WMSIVDT D WHERE B.BUYER = #{KEY_BUYER} AND B.PO_NO = #{KEY_PO_NO} AND B.PO_SEQ = #{KEY_PO_SEQ} AND DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',C.INV_NO,D.INV_NO) = #{KEY_INV_NO} AND DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',C.INV_SEQ,D.INV_SEQ) = #{KEY_INV_SEQ} AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND C.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND C.INV_NO = D.S_INV_NO(+) AND C.INV_SEQ = D.S_INV_SEQ(+) AND D.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' ) S
